name: Melanotan II
description: Lab-made ring-shaped 7-amino-acid peptide modelled on alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone

note.lead: Later reports are mostly of harm.
note.text: Case reports describe melanoma, priapism, muscle breakdown and a brain-swelling syndrome. Single cases cannot show cause.

bullets: **Darkened skin** and caused spontaneous erections in its first human test
**In people,** the mechanism for erections is not established
Serious harms described in case reports

practical.soldAs: Not approved; sold labelled “research use only”
practical.sport: Not named; S0 may cover it (no WADA ruling)

regulatory.text: “Research use” labels do not permit human sale
Not named; S0 may cover it

references: Wessells et al., J Urol, Melanotan II in psychogenic ED, Aug 1998
FDA, bulk drug substances with significant safety risks (Category 2), Apr 2026
Habbema et al., Int J Dermatol, melanotan review, Oct 2017
